title: Trump Media, licensing, golf and merchandise income during the presidency
summary: Outside crypto, Trump's own 2025 disclosure (filed 30 June 2026) shows large business revenue but almost no new cash from Trump Media. Reported 2025 revenue includes about $413.6M from US golf clubs and resorts, among them Mar-a-Lago at $77.5M and Doral at $121.9M. Scotland added about GBP 30.4M and Doonbeg about EUR 18.9M. Foreign licensing, management and development fees come to about $63.1M by our line-by-line sum, with $38.4M of that from the Gulf; press tallies of $59-60M are narrower. Unnamed family members hold 20% of the licensing companies that received $54.5M of those fees. Merchandise royalties were about $5.0M and book royalties about $3.0M. All of these are revenue, not profit. Trump Media is paper value only. SEC filings show the trust's 114,750,000 shares were never sold, paid no dividend and were not reported as pledged, while their market value fell from about $4.6B before the inauguration to about $0.53-0.64B in Oct-Nov 2026. Several items have no documented figure: 2026 income (not yet disclosed), LIV Golf fees, Mar-a-Lago initiation income, and any Trump Mobile payment to Trump.

sub_claims.statement: Trump's Trump Media stake is held in his revocable trust, has not been sold and pays nothing.
sub_claims.finding: The December 2025 Schedule 13D/A shows 114,750,000 DJT shares held by the Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust, of which Trump is settlor and sole beneficiary. Donald Trump Jr. is sole trustee with sole voting and investment power. That was 41.5% of 276,497,911 shares outstanding; the November 2026 TAE merger prospectus gives about 41%. The same count is in his 2025 and 2026 OGE filings and in the April 2025 resale registration, which registered all 114.75M shares for possible resale. The 13D/A reports no transactions in the prior 60 days and no pledge. The only Forms 4 filed under Trump's own SEC number date from December 2024. The OGE 2026 filing lists the stake as 'Over $50,000,000' with income 'None (or less than $201)'. TMTG's 10-K says there are no current plans to pay cash dividends, and its Q3 2026 10-Q says the planned digital-token distribution to shareholders was discontinued. Trump's name-and-likeness licence to TMTG is royalty-free: $100 paid once, and no other amounts paid to him. Under a December 2025 support agreement, the trust must vote for the TAE merger (vote set for 14 Dec 2026) and faces transfer restrictions.

sub_claims.statement: The paper value of the Trump Media stake has fallen sharply during the term.
sub_claims.finding: At 114,750,000 shares, our arithmetic on closing prices gives: $40.03 on 17 Jan 2025, about $4.59B; $35.59 on 21 Jan 2025, the first trading day of the term, about $4.08B; $13.24 on 31 Dec 2025, about $1.52B; $5.59 on 30 Oct 2026 (the price stated in the SEC prospectus), about $641M; and $4.64 on 13 Nov 2026, about $532M. That is a paper decline of about $4.06B since just before the inauguration. DJT never closed above its 21 Jan 2025 level in the period. Forbes and Benzinga relayed similar stake values ($683M at $5.95 on 3 Nov 2026). TMTG's own results swung from a FY2025 net loss of $712.3M on $3.68M of revenue to Q3 2026 net income of $409.7M, mostly from investment gains. None of this reaches Trump as cash.

sub_claims.statement: Golf clubs and resorts, including Mar-a-Lago, earned record revenue in 2025.
sub_claims.finding:
The 2026 OGE filing reports these 2025 revenue figures:
- Mar-a-Lago Club LLC: $77,482,488, against $50,122,259 in 2024.
- Doral (Trump Endeavor 12 LLC): $121,861,496, against $110,418,239.
- Bedminster (Lamington Farm Club): $37,603,295.
- West Palm Beach: $36,905,293.
- Jupiter: $31,620,799.
- Washington DC: $24,867,648.
- Charlotte: $21,414,854.
- Colts Neck: $17,469,437.
- Los Angeles: $16,581,213.
- Westchester: $11,278,958.
- Philadelphia: $8,403,643.
- Hudson Valley: $8,135,258.
The US total is about $413.6M. Abroad, Turnberry reported GBP 23,640,577 (GBP 24,228,853 in 2024), Aberdeen GBP 6,738,799 (GBP 4,471,993) and Doonbeg EUR 14,151,905 plus EUR 4,782,443 for hotel operations. CNN's 'more than $290M' covers five properties and matches the filing ($293.4M). Front Office Sports' $394.8M covers golf entities only. These are gross revenue figures; the form does not report profit, and Doral carries a mortgage of over $50M.

sub_claims.statement: Mar-a-Lago's initiation fee was raised to $1 million.
sub_claims.finding: CNN reports the fee was $100,000 before 2016 and was raised to $1M in 2024, citing 'a person familiar with the matter'. This is single-source. The disclosure does not split initiation fees from other club revenue, so how much of the $27.4M rise in Mar-a-Lago revenue came from fees cannot be determined. CNN also reports $1M-a-head MAGA Inc. dinners and RNC spending of more than $1M at Mar-a-Lago and Doral in 2025-26; FEC data cited by CNN show political committees paying both venues.

sub_claims.statement: LIV Golf events and other bookings at Trump courses pay the Trump Organization.
sub_claims.finding: LIV held events at Doral in 2025. In 2026 it held LIV Golf Virginia at Trump National Washington DC and planned a New York-area event at Bedminster, and the PGA Tour's Cadillac Championship moved to Doral (Front Office Sports). No fee for any event is disclosed; Trump has called the payments a 'rental fee' and 'peanuts'. They sit inside each club's revenue line, so they cannot be isolated. The White House says the 14-15 Dec 2026 G20 summit at Doral will be billed 'at cost' with 'no profit'. No accounting has been published, and CREW says no method has been explained.

sub_claims.statement: Foreign licensing and development deals (Dar Global and others) paid Trump tens of millions in 2025.
sub_claims.finding:
Exact amounts from the 2026 OGE filing:
- Gulf: $38.39M in total.
  - Dar Al Arkan entities: Dubai tower $10,361,459, Saudi Arabia $9,243,574 and Oman $949,642.
  - Dar Global Holdings: Doha $5,250,000.
  - So Dar-linked fees come to $25.80M, the same figure CNBC reports.
  - Damac: Abu Dhabi $5,000,000, Al Raha Beach $5,000,000, Dubai golf licence $1,335,140 and Dubai golf management $1,254,744, for $12.59M.
- Elsewhere: $24.66M.
  - India: $10.21M across Gurgaon, Hyderabad (a Reliance 4IR entity), Noida, Pune, Mumbai Worli and Kolkata.
  - Bucharest: $5M.
  - Vietnam (Hung Yen): $5M.
  - Korea: a $2M non-refundable development fee under a letter of intent with Base Co.
  - Philippines: $1.59M.
  - Istanbul: $0.58M.
  - Lido, Indonesia, management: $0.28M.
Our line-by-line foreign total is $63.06M. CNBC reports $59.5M, CNN 'nearly $60M' and CREW $59M of 'licensing and development fees'; the differences come from which management and development lines each counts. The Diriyah hotel and T1 Mobile licensing entities reported no 2025 income. Fees are paid whether or not a project is built. Not all of this accrues to the President: twelve of the fee-earning LLCs ($54.49M of the $63.06M) are owned 79% by his structure and 20% by unnamed 'Trump Family Members' (see C99).

sub_claims.statement: Branded merchandise and royalties (watches, sneakers, Bible, guitars, fragrances, books) earn Trump royalties.
sub_claims.finding:
2025 royalties in the 2026 filing:
- Trump Watches (The Best Watches on Earth LLC): $4,700,000, against $2.8M in 2024.
- Sneakers and fragrances (45Footwear LLC): $67,634, against $2.5M.
- '45' guitar (LMA Productions): $35,920, against $1,055,100.
- Greenwood Bible: $208,486, against $1,306,035.
- Books: 'Save America' $1,893,965, 'Letters to Trump' $590,730 and 'A MAGA Journey' $552,685.
Merchandise totals about $5.0M and books about $3.0M. The filing notes that the watch and sneaker licence agreements were 'inadvertently omitted from the prior report'. Also listed: $200,000 for a December 2022 speaking engagement, paid in May 2025. NFT licensing (NFT INT) showed nothing in 2025, against about $1.16M in 2024. The $635M 'Celebration Coins' meme-coin royalty is crypto and belongs to C97.

sub_claims.statement: Trump Mobile and the T1 phone generate income for Trump.
sub_claims.finding: DT Marks Mobile LLC, the licensor to T1 Mobile LLC, reported no income for 2025, only a bank balance of $50,001-$100,000 and deferred organisational costs. A May 2026 Moneywise article syndicated by Yahoo Finance estimates about 590,000 $100 deposits, about $59M. The estimate is not sourced to company data, and the money went to the operator, not to Trump. Shipping was announced for May 2026 (CNN). No 2026 licence payment is public.

The latest annual filing covers calendar 2025. Income for January-November 2026 from clubs, licensing, merchandise or Trump Mobile has not been disclosed and will appear in the filing due in 2027. Periodic transaction reports (278-T) cover securities trades, not business income.

sub_claims.statement: The ethics arrangement keeps Trump away from the business and bars deals with foreign governments.
sub_claims.finding: The January 2025 Trump Organization white paper puts the businesses in a trust managed by his children and bars new deals directly with foreign governments while allowing private foreign deals. Outside adviser William Burck reviews major deals, and profits from foreign-government spending are to go to the US Treasury. The filings show the income still accrues to Trump through the revocable trust, of which he is sole beneficiary. No figure for any 2025 Treasury donation was found; the last reported donation was $151,470 for 2017. Qatar's Doha licensee is Dar Global, but the project sits within Qatari Diar's development (see C16/C31).

sub_claims.statement: Trump took on new borrowing in 2025.
sub_claims.finding: Part 8 of the 2026 filing lists a Charles Schwab Bank 'Pledged Asset Line' of over $50M at 3.90%, incurred in 2025, without naming the collateral. The TMTG 13D/A discloses no pledge of DJT shares. The same Part 8 shows the Seven Springs, 1125 South Ocean and 40 Wall Street mortgages paid off in June-July 2025.

corrections: Claimed (C31, The National/IndexBox): about $21.9M from Dar Al Arkan in 2025, 'nearly identical' to 2024. The record shows: the three Dar Al Arkan licensee lines sum to $20.55M, and adding the $5.25M Doha fee from Dar Global Holdings gives $25.80M, the figure CNBC reports. The Gulf total of about $38.4M is correct.

Claimed (C31/C88, citing Eastern Herald): Damac's roughly $12.5M is an estimate because the form uses ranges. The record shows: all four Damac-linked fee lines are exact dollar amounts and sum to $12,589,884. Only asset values on those lines are ranges.

Claimed (C20 and some Forbes pieces): the trust holds about 52-53% of TMTG. The record shows: about 52% was correct from the Dec 2024 transfer until the end of May 2025 (220,657,014 shares outstanding at 31 Dec 2024). After the 29 May 2025 private placement of 55,857,181 shares the same 114.75M shares were 41.5% at Dec 2025 (13D/A) and about 41% at Nov 2026 (prospectus).

Press figures for foreign licensing differ: CNN 'nearly $60M', CNBC $59.5M, CREW $59M of licensing and development fees, and our line-by-line sum of all foreign licensing, management and development lines $63.1M. The difference is definitional, not an error.

Front Office Sports attributes Bedminster's $37.6M to Lamington Family Holdings LLC. The record shows: the revenue is reported by Lamington Farm Club, LLC; Lamington Family Holdings holds a 10-acre lot.
C17's 2024 royalty figures (watches $2.8M, sneakers and fragrances $2.5M, Bible $1,306,035, NFTs about $1.16M) check out against the 2025 filing. In 2025, every line except watches fell sharply.
16 Nov 2026 (audit): the first version of this check dated the end of the trust's 52% stake to March 2025; it lasted until the 29 May 2025 private placement.
denials_and_context: Trump Organization statement on the 2026 filing: it 'demonstrates that The Trump Organization continues to maintain a strong financial position, supported by world class, valuable assets, substantial liquidity and a conservative balance sheet', and its length 'underscores our commitment to transparency' (NBC News via Yahoo).
White House statement: 'Neither the President nor his family has ever engaged — or will ever engage — in conflicts of interest' (NBC News via Yahoo).
Trump told reporters: 'You know why I'm profiting? Because the stock market's going up. Everybody's profiting', and 'I never speak to any of the people that run the money' (CNN).

The Trump Organization says outside financial institutions manage the investments using automated trading. The January 2025 ethics agreement puts the businesses in a trust run by his children, bars new deals with foreign governments but allows private foreign ones, and Eric Trump said the company would 'vastly exceed' its legal and ethical obligations (AP).
The White House says the G20 at Doral will be 'at-cost' with 'no profit' from the State Department or any foreign government.

Context: these are gross revenues from businesses that existed before the term (except the newer licences). They are not profits, and nothing here shows the income was earned because of the presidency. The 2025 licence fees come from private developers, which the 2025 ethics policy permits.
Context: the fall in Trump Media's value is a paper loss, as was the earlier paper gain. No sale has been reported.
Context: 'Trump Family Members' hold 20% limited-partner interests in most new foreign licensing LLCs, so the fee lines are not wholly the President's income; the form shows no distributions.

Stake percentage: corrected the end date of the 52% stake from March 2025 to the end of May 2025 (FY2025 10-K: 220,657,014 shares at 31 Dec 2024; 55,857,181 PIPE shares on 29 May 2025). 41.5% (13D/A, 15 Dec 2025) and about 41% (prospectus) upheld.
